title:
REST type for SendGrid Email Address Validation API

This exists as a separate type from {@link SendGridApi} because SendGrid makes users generate a separate API
token specifically for email address validation
@see https://sendgrid.com/docs/ui/managing-contacts/email-address-validation/

You can use the script below in static console to configure the API token:
```
SendGridEmailAddressValidationApi.setApiUrlAndAuth(
  'https://api.sendgrid.com/v3', // The API url
  'Bearer <token>', // The API token generated in SendGrid
  ConfigOverride.CLUSTER
)
```
The SendGridEmailAddressValidationApi uses the same url configured for {@link SendGridApi}
name: SendGridEmailAddressValidationApi
